Aries.name: Aries
Aries.description: First of the zodiac, you are the spark before the fire — the raw, unhesitating impulse of creation itself. Aries does not wait for permission to exist; you arrive like dawn breaking, certain and unstoppable. Where others see a wall, you see a beginning.
Aries.mythology: The golden ram whose fleece became the object of Jason's legendary quest, sacrificed to the heavens for carrying the innocent to safety.

Taurus.name: Taurus
Taurus.description: Born beneath the Bull, you are the deep root and the ripening fruit — an unshakable presence in a world of noise. Taurus knows that the truest things are built slowly, savored fully, and never rushed. You are the calm that outlasts the storm, and the beauty that refuses to be hurried.
Taurus.mythology: The disguise of Zeus himself, who took the form of a magnificent white bull to carry Europa across the sea to distant shores.

Gemini.name: Gemini
Gemini.description: Under the sign of the Twins, you contain multitudes — every conversation a doorway, every idea a constellation waiting to be connected. Gemini is the mind in motion, forever weaving meaning between distant thoughts. You are proof that a single soul can hold two truths at once and love them both.
Gemini.mythology: Castor and Pollux, the inseparable twins — one mortal, one immortal — who chose to share eternity rather than be parted by death.

Cancer.name: Cancer
Cancer.description: Ruled by the Moon, you carry the tides within you — a heart that remembers everything and a love that runs deeper than words can reach. Cancer builds sanctuaries out of tenderness, and shelters the vulnerable as though it were a sacred duty. You feel the whole world, and you make it feel like home.
Cancer.mythology: The loyal crab sent by Hera to aid the Hydra, honored in the stars for its unwavering courage against impossible odds.

Leo.name: Leo
Leo.description: Child of the Sun, you were born to burn brightly and unashamed. Leo does not simply enter a room — you illuminate it, warming everyone who stands in your light. Beneath the golden mane beats a heart of extraordinary loyalty; you love as fiercely as you shine, and you shine without apology.
Leo.mythology: The invincible Nemean Lion whose hide no weapon could pierce, immortalized by Hercules and raised into the heavens.

Virgo.name: Virgo
Virgo.description: Under the sign of the Maiden, you see the sacred hidden in the small — the perfection possible in a single well-made thing. Virgo serves not from obligation but from love, mending what is broken and refining what is rough. Yours is the quiet genius of care taken when no one is watching.
Virgo.mythology: Astraea, the celestial virgin of justice, the last immortal to walk among mortals before ascending to become the stars.

Libra.name: Libra
Libra.description: Born beneath the Scales, you are the search for balance made human — forever seeking the point where beauty and justice meet. Libra understands that harmony is not the absence of difference but the art of holding it gently. You are the diplomat of the soul, weighing every heart with grace.
Libra.mythology: The scales of Astraea, goddess of justice, the only sign represented by an object rather than a living thing — balance itself, made eternal.

Scorpio.name: Scorpio
Scorpio.description: Under the sign of the Scorpion, you were born to dive where others fear to look. Scorpio does not flinch from darkness — you transform it, emerging again and again from your own ashes. Yours is a love that consumes and a loyalty that endures beyond death; to be truly known by you is to be known completely.
Scorpio.mythology: The scorpion sent to fell the mighty hunter Orion, placed opposite him in the sky so the two eternal rivals may never meet.

Sagittarius.name: Sagittarius
Sagittarius.description: Born beneath the Archer, you aim your arrow at the horizon and never stop chasing it. Sagittarius is the eternal seeker — hungry for truth, for distance, for the next great expanse of experience. You carry an incurable faith that the world is wide and worth exploring, and you make others believe it too.
Sagittarius.mythology: Chiron, the wise and immortal centaur — teacher of heroes — who traded his own eternity to end another's suffering.

Capricorn.name: Capricorn
Capricorn.description: Under the sign of the Sea-Goat, you were built to climb — patient, unshakable, ascending mountains that would defeat lesser souls. Capricorn understands time as an ally, not an enemy; you build things meant to outlast you. Beneath the composure lies a quiet, dry warmth known only to those who earn your trust.
Capricorn.mythology: The sea-goat Pan, who leapt into the Nile to escape the monster Typhon, transforming into a creature half-earth, half-water.

Aquarius.name: Aquarius
Aquarius.description: Born beneath the Water-Bearer, you belong to the future before it arrives. Aquarius sees the world not as it is but as it could be, and refuses to accept anything less. You are the beautiful rebel, the mind that pours new ideas into a thirsty world — walking your own path so others may one day walk beside you.
Aquarius.mythology: Ganymede, the mortal youth carried to Olympus by Zeus to serve as cupbearer to the gods, pouring the waters of eternal life.

Pisces.name: Pisces
Pisces.description: Born under the sign of the Fish, you carry the depth of every ocean within you. Pisces is the final sign — the culmination of every lesson the zodiac has learned — granting you an intuition that borders on the otherworldly. You feel what others cannot name, and dream in colors that don't yet exist.
Pisces.mythology: Aphrodite and her son Eros, who transformed into fish and tied themselves together with a cord so they would never be separated in the chaos.
